beforeDevCommand.script: sh -c 'cargo build -p easytidy-server --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-dock --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && pnpm dev'

beforeBuildCommand.script: sh -c 'cargo build -p easytidy-server --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-dock --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy --release && cargo build -p easytidy --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mkdir -p binaries && cp ../../target/release/easytidy binaries/easytidy-$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE && cp ../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/easytidy-server binaries/easytidy-server-$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE && cp ../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/easytidy-dock binaries/easytidy-dock-$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE && cp ../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/ets binaries/ets-$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE && pnpm build'
